title: Orbit and Signal
author: Elodie Nystrom
blurb: Cyrus Whitlock, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
